entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-03
entry.content:
Issues

  • DNX: "Unable to cast object of type 'Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.Commands.Dnx.DnxCommandDefinition ...' error while running dotnet tool #52819
  • Investigate consolidating ReplaceFilesWithSymbolicLinks into DeduplicateAssembliesWithLinks #52815
  • Add `dnx` command to dotnetup for standalone tool execution #52814
  • CA2016 does not fire for methods with separate overloads #52811
  • Packaging tools should warn if the user is using a custom nuspec file #52809
  • Microsoft.VisualStudio.JavaScript.SDK FileNotFoundException System.Text.Json, Version=9.0.0.11 #52807
  • dotnet run should ignore Directory.Build.props and Directory.Build.targets #52804
  • [Linux] Dotnet watch to run the project, close the page in the browser, the error "[2026-02-03T08:37:46Z ERROR viaduct::backend::ffi] Missing HTTP status" is displayed on CMD #52800
  • Unify dotnetup and Microsoft.Dotnet.Installation version in Directory.Build.props #52795

Closed

  • [10.0.101]`dotnet new gitattributes` emits no file #52307
  • Revise `CreateFromFilteredSolutionFile` implementation for trailing comma (and allowing comments) #51929
  • Convert all DotnetCommand tests that call "new" to DotnetNewCommand #29438
  • Avoid nulls in GenerateGlobalUsings task Lines Output #52803
